en: Black‑and‑white elevated view over a Central European riverside town. In the foreground there is a steeply roofed villa with timber detailing and turrets. Below, curving railway tracks run parallel to the river, with a station area and several multi‑storey urban buildings in late‑19th‑century style. On the right, passenger steamers are moored along a quay where people walk beside the water. In the background, terraced fields and wooded hills rise sharply, including a bright rock or quarry face cut into the hillside.
